as_told.title: JFK and LBJ visit Los Alamos weeks after Malmgren's briefing

plain: In 1962, the story goes, a young government man named Harold Malmgren, later a presidential adviser, was briefed at Los Alamos, the US nuclear weapons laboratory in New Mexico, and met a man there named Lawrence Preston Gise. Soon afterwards President John F. Kennedy came out to Los Alamos himself. Michels tells it in his own framing, saying the visit came a month after Malmgren's briefing and that it was not really normal for Kennedy to come out and just check on this. Pippa Malmgren, relaying what Harold Malmgren told her, tells it a little differently: she says it was only a couple of weeks later, and that Vice President Lyndon B. Johnson and both men's teams came too. The timing is told as a sign that whatever Malmgren was shown reached the very top.
